semantic_review: One clock identity through capabilities, actual origin configuration, question, equations and elapsed readings.
Admissible K-rest/t and k-rest/tau alternatives are distinct situations; current placement is k origin. Representative position is at rest, not every internal moving part.
Every self-frame time has a calibrated local display; all candidate displays give that coordinate time. Reject a second wrong display and preserve exact scale/origin.
All observer times have same-event paired records; preserve histories, current position, nonempty positive intervals and full candidate coverage.
The described question takes a positive rate candidate and all ordered record pairs, but contains neither the square-root answer nor answer existence/uniqueness.
Keep both tau=beta*(t-v*x/V^2) and x=v*t for the same clock location and event; retain zero k spatial coordinates and signed t.
Keep both equalities tau=t*sqrt(1-(v/V)^2)=t-(1-sqrt(1-(v/V)^2))*t, positive root and reciprocal beta.
Use differences for positive elapsed time and same positive conversion scale for both K and tau differences and all record pairs. No requirement for a measured exactly-one-second pair.
Exact unit delay 1-f and quadratic approximation (v/V)^2/2 stay distinct; common positive constants and neighborhoods quantify the O(u^4) residual, not finite samples.
Keep author thought-setting, question, obviousness, consequence, qualified alternative, attribution and text order. Quoted premises do not execute.
Do not import the later A/B transport or acceleration discussion or add concrete residual bounds to the source assertion.
